dict.string: This app requires access to your microphone to record your voice during the meeting.
This app requires access to the system audio to record voice from other participants in the meeting.
Anarlog uses your contacts to match calendar attendees with names and email addresses saved on your Mac.
This app requires access to your calendar to read events.
This app requires access to your reminders to sync and manage tasks.
This app requires access to your local network to function properly.
